method: Compositing generation with one targeted vertical-spacing refinement

sourceImages.role: Authentic TRIAD.io v0.8 gameplay and game-visual reference
web-app-hub composition and finish reference only

prompt:
Use case: compositing
Asset type: web-app-hub game thumbnail, landscape 3:2
Primary request: create one polished promotional thumbnail for the development game TRIAD.io, using the real gameplay and the hub's established thumbnail composition.
Input images: Image 1: authentic TRIAD.io v0.8 gameplay screenshot and source for all game visuals; Image 2: existing web-app-hub thumbnail used only as a layout and finish reference. Do not copy Image 2's character, landscape, or wording.
Scene/backdrop: use the deep navy-blue arena and subtle grid from Image 1 as the full background.
Subject: on the left, three enlarged, friendly round elemental game characters matching TRIAD.io's actual circular avatar design and palette: fire (orange/red), water (cyan/blue), and grass (green). Keep their design simple and faithful to the game, without props, costumes, or extra effects. On the right, show an inset of the actual gameplay from Image 1, retaining its real arena, HUD, and leaderboard. The screenshot inset must remain recognizable as the genuine game screen, not a fabricated interface.
Style/medium: polished 2D game thumbnail, crisp and cheerful, matching the hub reference's clean promotional style, not 3D.
Composition/framing: 3:2 horizontal canvas. Enlarged elemental characters grouped on the left; clear rounded screenshot inset on the right; a wide soft-white rounded caption strip across the bottom, following the reference's hierarchy. Keep all important content inside safe margins.
Color palette: retain the game's navy, cyan, gold, orange, and green accents; dark navy lettering on the pale caption strip.
Text (verbatim): main caption 「三すくみで、大きくなれ！」; small app-name chip 「TRIAD.io」. Render each exactly once, legibly, with rounded bold Japanese sans-serif lettering; no other text outside the authentic screenshot inset.
Constraints: use Image 1 for authentic game visuals; preserve the screenshot inset's real game identity and UI; use Image 2 only for composition/layout polish; no unrelated game elements.
Avoid: invented controls, device frame, play button, extra characters, extra text, altered or misspelled caption, copied Mogumon character or landscape, logos other than the exact app-name chip, watermark.
iterationPrompt:
Use case: compositing
Asset type: final web-app-hub game thumbnail, landscape 3:2
Primary request: make one targeted layout refinement to this existing TRIAD.io thumbnail.
Input images: Image 1: edit target, the already-approved generated TRIAD.io thumbnail.
Scene/backdrop: retain the same deep navy arena backdrop and subtle grid.
Subject: retain the same three fire, water, and grass game mascots and the same authentic TRIAD.io gameplay inset.
Composition/framing: change only vertical spacing. Reserve the top 12% of the canvas as uninterrupted quiet dark-navy grid negative space, with no mascot, screenshot frame, or bright orb entering that band. Scale the mascot group and gameplay inset slightly smaller if needed and move them down while keeping the white caption strip along the bottom, all content fully inside the frame, and the existing left-mascot/right-screen hierarchy.
Text (verbatim): preserve exactly 「三すくみで、大きくなれ！」 and 「TRIAD.io」, unchanged, each once.
Constraints: preserve the current mascot designs, colors, expressions, screenshot identity and HUD, screenshot inset border, caption-strip shape, type style, and all existing visual details; change only the vertical spacing needed for the quiet top band.
Avoid: new or removed characters, new UI, changed wording, typography changes, crop loss, watermark, or any change to the caption.
